name: dsh-toolbox
description: Local-first DeepSeek Harness plugins plus a profile and plugin control plane.

scripts.check: node scripts/validate-workspace.js && npm test && npm run build --workspace @dsh-toolbox/dsh-switchboard-gui && npm run test:sites --workspace @dsh-toolbox/dsh-switchboard-gui && npm run smoke:gui
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @dsh-toolbox/product-research-workbench && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @dsh-toolbox/context-switchboard && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @dsh-toolbox/plugin-preflight && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @dsh-toolbox/compatibility-radar && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @dsh-toolbox/dsh-switchboard
scripts.switchboard:gui: npm run build --workspace @dsh-toolbox/dsh-switchboard-gui && npm run start --workspace @dsh-toolbox/dsh-switchboard-gui
